knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r load-data}
asthma_precip_pm25 <- read_csv("datasets/asthma_precip_pm25_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

temp_raw <- read_csv("datasets/daily_temp_nyc.csv") |>
  mutate(
    date     = as.Date(DATE),
    temp_avg = (as.numeric(TMAX) + as.numeric(TMIN)) / 2
  ) |>
  select(date, temp_avg)

# borough populations (2016–2019 average, persons)
borough_pop <- tribble(
  ~borough,        ~population,
  "Bronx",         1432132,
  "Brooklyn",      2582830,
  "Manhattan",     1628701,
  "Queens",        2278906,
  "Staten Island",  476179
)

final_dat <- asthma_precip_pm25 |>
  left_join(temp_raw, by = "date") |>
  left_join(borough_pop, by = "borough") |>
  mutate(
    rate_per_100k = asthma_er_count / population * 100000
  )

# pollen data (city-wide)
pollen_dat <- read_csv("datasets/asthma_precip_pm25_pollen.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  select(date, pollen)

final_dat <- final_dat |>
  left_join(pollen_dat, by = "date")

# age-stratified data (city-wide, summed across boroughs)
age_dat <- read_csv("asthma_precip_age.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(age != "All age groups") |>
  mutate(age = case_when(
    age == "Ages 0-4 years"   ~ "Ages 0–4",
    age == "Ages 5-17 years"  ~ "Ages 5–17",
    age == "Ages 18-64 years" ~ "Ages 18–64",
    age == "Ages 65+ years"   ~ "Ages 65+",
    TRUE                      ~ age
  )) |>
  group_by(date, age) |>
  summarise(asthma_er_count = sum(asthma_er_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r precipitation-categories}
# compute city-wide percentile thresholds from all non-zero days,
# matching the dlnm analysis approach
p90 <- quantile(final_dat$ppt, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
p95 <- quantile(final_dat$ppt, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
p99 <- quantile(final_dat$ppt, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf(
  "Precipitation thresholds (city-wide):\n  90th pct: %.2f mm\n  95th pct: %.2f mm\n  99th pct: %.2f mm\n",
  p90, p95, p99
))

final_dat <- final_dat |>
  mutate(
    ppt_cat = case_when(
      ppt == 0              ~ "No rain (0 mm)",
      ppt < p90             ~ paste0("Light (>0 to <", round(p90, 1), " mm)"),
      ppt < p95             ~ paste0("Moderate (", round(p90, 1), "–<", round(p95, 1), " mm)"),
      ppt < p99             ~ paste0("Heavy (", round(p95, 1), "–<", round(p99, 1), " mm)"),
      TRUE                  ~ paste0("Very heavy (≥", round(p99, 1), " mm)")
    ),
    ppt_cat = factor(ppt_cat, levels = c(
      paste0("No rain (0 mm)"),
      paste0("Light (>0 to <", round(p90, 1), " mm)"),
      paste0("Moderate (", round(p90, 1), "–<", round(p95, 1), " mm)"),
      paste0("Heavy (", round(p95, 1), "–<", round(p99, 1), " mm)"),
      paste0("Very heavy (≥", round(p99, 1), " mm)")
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
# written as median (Q1, Q3)
fmt_median_iqr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))
}

# written as mean ± SD
fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(x), sd(x))
}

# n written as %
fmt_n_pct <- function(n, total) {
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / total)
}
```

```{r build-table-data}
boroughs_ordered <- c("Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Staten Island")

# compute all summary rows
summarise_stratum <- function(data) {
  n_days        <- nrow(data)
  pop_val       <- round(mean(data$population, na.rm = TRUE))
  visits_miqr   <- fmt_median_iqr(data$asthma_er_count)
  rate_msd      <- fmt_mean_sd(data$rate_per_100k)
  temp_msd      <- fmt_mean_sd(data$temp_avg)
  pollen_msd    <- fmt_mean_sd(data$pollen)

  # ppt category counts
  ppt_counts <- data |>
    count(ppt_cat, .drop = FALSE) |>
    mutate(fmt = fmt_n_pct(n, n_days))

  list(
    n_days      = n_days,
    population  = formatC(pop_val, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    visits_miqr = visits_miqr,
    rate_msd    = rate_msd,
    temp_msd    = temp_msd,
    ppt_counts  = ppt_counts,
    pollen_msd  = pollen_msd
  )
}

# compute per borough and overall
strata <- c(boroughs_ordered, "Overall")

summaries <- lapply(strata, function(b) {
  d <- if (b == "Overall") final_dat else filter(final_dat, borough == b)
  summarise_stratum(d)
})
names(summaries) <- strata


ppt_levels <- levels(final_dat$ppt_cat)

# age rows
age_levels <- c("Ages 0–4", "Ages 5–17", "Ages 18–64", "Ages 65+")

age_summary <- age_dat |>
  group_by(age) |>
  summarise(fmt = fmt_median_iqr(asthma_er_count), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(age = factor(age, levels = age_levels)) |>
  arrange(age)

# build long table rows
row_labels <- c(
  "Person-days",
  "Population",
  "Daily asthma ED visits, median (IQR)",
  paste0("  ", age_levels),
  "Asthma ED rate per 100,000, mean ± SD",
  "Daily mean temperature (°F), mean ± SD",
  "Daily pollen count, mean ± SD",
  paste0("  ", ppt_levels)
)

make_col <- function(s) {
  ppt_row <- s$ppt_counts |>
    arrange(ppt_cat) |>
    pull(fmt)

  c(
    as.character(s$n_days),
    s$population,
    s$visits_miqr,
    age_summary$fmt,   # same city-wide values repeated across borough columns
    s$rate_msd,
    s$temp_msd,
    s$pollen_msd,
    ppt_row
  )
}

table_df <- data.frame(
  Characteristic = row_labels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (b in strata) {
  table_df[[b]] <- make_col(summaries[[b]])
}
```

```{r render-table}
# rows can be grouped
n_age <- length(age_levels)
n_ppt <- length(ppt_levels)

n_outcome <- 1 + n_age + 3  # visits header + age rows + rate + temp + pollen

table_df <- table_df |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      row_number() <= 2                        ~ "Study period",
      row_number() <= 2 + n_outcome            ~ "Outcome & covariates",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Precipitation exposure"
    )
  )

table_df$Characteristic <- trimws(table_df$Characteristic)

table_df |>
  gt(groupname_col = "group") |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Table 1. Descriptive Statistics by NYC Borough, 2016–2019",
    subtitle = "Precipitation categories based on city-wide percentile thresholds"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Borough",
    columns = all_of(boroughs_ordered)
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    Characteristic  = "Characteristic",
    Bronx           = "Bronx",
    Brooklyn        = "Brooklyn",
    Manhattan       = "Manhattan",
    Queens          = "Queens",
    `Staten Island` = "Staten Island",
    Overall         = "Overall"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(indent = px(15)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = Characteristic,
      rows    = Characteristic %in% c(trimws(ppt_levels), age_levels)
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f7f7f7"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  opt_table_font(font = "Times New Roman") |>
  tab_options(
    table.width              = pct(100),
    column_labels.font.size  = px(13),
    table.font.size          = px(12),
    row_group.font.size      = px(13),
    heading.title.font.size  = px(14),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12)
  )
```

### Choropleth map

```{r choropleth-map}
nyc_fips <- c("36005", "36047", "36061", "36081", "36085")

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
nyc_sf <- counties(state = "NY", cb = TRUE, year = 2019) |>
  filter(GEOID %in% nyc_fips) |>
  mutate(borough = case_when(
    GEOID == "36005" ~ "Bronx",
    GEOID == "36047" ~ "Brooklyn",
    GEOID == "36061" ~ "Manhattan",
    GEOID == "36081" ~ "Queens",
    GEOID == "36085" ~ "Staten Island"
  ))

borough_stats <- final_dat |>
  group_by(borough) |>
  summarise(mean_rate = mean(rate_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

map_dat <- nyc_sf |>
  left_join(borough_stats, by = "borough")

ggplot(map_dat) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = borough), size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette   = "Reds",
    direction = 1,
    name      = "Mean daily asthma\nED visits per 100,000"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mean Daily Asthma ED Visit Rate by NYC Borough, 2016–2019") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/map_asthma_rate.png",
  plot     = last_plot(),
  width    = 8,
  height   = 5,
  dpi      = 300
)
```
